title: A Thermo-Kinematic Operator Splitting Framework for Stefan Problems Based on Extreme Learning Machines
summary: Solving Stefan problems via neural networks is challenging because of the nonlinear coupling between the solution and the free boundary, which generally leads to a non-convex optimization problem when they are parameterized and optimized simultaneously. To address this difficulty, we propose a thermo-kinematic operator splitting framework based on Extreme Learning Machines (ELMs) to decouple the solution reconstruction from the free boundary evolution.
